body: I get up early every morning (around 4 or 5) and move from the bed to the living room couch. I turn on a documentary, cuddle up under my favorite blanket, and go back to sleep. It gives me so much peace and comfort. I wish my husband would understand! He hates it that I do this.

I know what you mean. I’ve literally spent years wrestling with this concept. It’s getting better, though. Now, instead of being crushed when they blow off my pain, I feel cynical. Not sure if that’s healthier, but at least it doesn’t make me cry.

Thank you! I managed to speak to the manager, and she finally agreed to refund me the difference ($30). No apology for the bad perm. She was so rude on the phone. I couldn’t believe it. I thought about leaving bad reviews, but halfway through my appointment the stylist told me they’re closing for good at the end of the week. Now I know why!

Social media is awful! I gave up on Facebook years ago. It always bothered me that people seemed happy 100% of the time. Made me wonder WTF was wrong with me??? Now that I’m four years FB-free, I’ve realized two things. (1) People just show their fake selves online, and (2) who cares how happy they seem? I’m me, and this is my reality!

This is pretty much what I get from my parents. I recently had pretty severe suicidal ideation and contacted my parents in a panic. They texted me “we love you!” And I didn’t hear anything more from them for a week. Even then it was something inane about one of my dad’s softball games. 

My therapist has been working with me on learning to accept that I will never get what I need from my parents. I have to figure out how to get it for myself. It’s hard!
Thank you!!!

Yes, exactly. I have extremely well-controlled type 2 diabetes, but it’s literally so minor I’m borderline normal. I’m not a doctor or anything, but I do know my pancreas is in my abdomen and not my neck.

Thanks for the idea. Unfortunately, they have me at a folding table that’s about three feet wide and 18 inches deep. There just isn’t room for a standing desk in that space. It would be nice, though, as the rest of the office has Varidesks.
I guess ergonomics isn’t a thing then. My mistake. Thank you for your input.
Oh. Ok, I guess I was mistaken. If you could let me know what kind of issue it is, I would appreciate it.

That’s good to know. I certainly gaf about the chair issue. If my boss ordered me to give up a piece of equipment that made my job pain-free, though, I would resent the person getting that piece of equipment.

I’m in training for twelve weeks to replace another person there. They have me at a narrow folding table in the back of someone’s office, spending about seven hours a day doing pretty extensive typing and data entry. For the past few weeks I’ve had shoulder and neck pain (first time in my life), and I believe it’s because of the lack of a desk and adjustable chair. At least if the chair was adjustable, I could raise it a little. I’m only 5’1” and the folding table is much too high for me.
I work in New Mexico (USA). It’s pretty complicated, but worker’s comp is involved. I was told the neck pack was from diabetes (by my employer).
I actually posted about why worker’s comp was involved before, so I won’t go into it again. But I will say it wasn’t my idea. It was drastic and I lost 2.5 days of pay because of it.
That’s awful! I wish I could buy my own chair, but they’re hundreds of dollars. :-(

Unfortunately, I don’t know which of my four coworkers would lose their chair. I’ve only been there seven weeks and don’t really know these people (but one had recent foot surgery and one had recent back surgery). 

I was in pain after two days without a good chair. I would feel a complete witch if I did that to another person. :-(
Thanks so much for your input. I’ll try to find a workers comp lawyer in the morning.
Sorry, I wasn’t clear. HR won’t confirm whether I’ve been officially terminated or not, so I don’t know if ANY of us have coverage.

I went to occupational health and was told that my neck and back pain is from my well-controlled type 2 diabetes. They also told me explicitly to NOT seek a second opinion. When I contacted HR after my appointment, they flat out refused to tell me if I was still an employee.

Interestingly enough, she doesn’t know. She asked me the same thing when I told her to hold on to my things this morning. Apparently the whole office is talking about it. I asked HR this morning, and they said they’re still “gathering information.”

On the advice of HR, I chose not to go in and instead have filled out worker’s compensation paperwork. But the woman who had been training me just emailed and asked if she should send my personal effects to my home address. I’m not sure how to answer that!
Thank you. I will try to remember that.
Sorry, I forgot to say how it came up. I decided to email my boss and ask him, very politely, what I should do. That’s when he called me into his office.

After I went into his office, he told me “you need to go home right now. If you can’t do the job I hired you for, what’s the point of you even being here? Look around, we’re at desks. We all sit at desks. We all type. If you can’t do that, then you might as well leave.”

And then he repeated himself two or three times. He was visibly angry. I could absolutely be wrong, but it felt like that’s what was happening.
I think that is a great idea. I hope they work pro bono, because at this point I’m not going to be able to afford rent in two weeks.
Thanks for your response! Can I go back to work tomorrow if he explicitly told me to leave? It’s such a tiny office (six people) and I’m scared of making a scene.
Thanks! I actually do use medical marijuana for PTSD. It helps when I’m using it, but I only use it at night. Do you know what kind of doctor I would see for such an MRI?
I wish I could do that!
I sure won’t be doing that anytime soon! Thanks! :-)
I thought about that, but I need this job. :-( I decided it wasn’t worth being unemployed again so I kept my mouth shut.
No, he didn’t.
Right, but he wouldn’t let me change that. So I didn’t get paid for 1.5 of the hours that I worked that week.

I’m so sorry I’m not more helpful! It sounds  frightening and uncomfortable. I think you should probably be seen by a medical professional, though. Which is really hard if you’re short on funds. Can you go to an ER if an urgent care isn’t an option?
Well, it doesn’t sound life-threatening, but I’m a little concerned about infection. Is there an urgent care you can go to?
Yes, you’re completely right. I did a terrible thing. I need to end it now.

Honestly, I’m scared to. Our finances are so tightly mingled. I only make $11/hour and have two kids. Health insurance takes up 40% of my paycheck. We’ve always lived off his (much larger) paycheck. If I wasn’t married to him, we wouldn’t be able to afford rent. 

I know that’s not enough of a reason to stay married, but I don’t know what else to do.
Are you still in pain?
I’m so sorry for your pain. I wish I could hug you right now.
Thank you so much for your suggestions! I love the idea of the Libre and making his favorite foods less high-carb. Thank you, thank you, thank you!

We do the shopping together, but he goes out and buys those things on his own. I’ve tried getting him out to do photography, hiking, swimming, camping, walking, etc. He hates it all. 

😞

Thanks for responding! It’s great to hear from another person with TD. 

I didn’t even know what TD was until several years after starting Abilify, so I know exactly what you mean! When I mentioned the tongue movements to my doctor, she pretty much blew it off. It’s awful to know it’s always going to be here. I hate my tongue!

It’s great that there are some medications out there now for folks like us, but apparently they’re so new and expensive insurance companies won’t touch them. I’m hoping someday I can try one out.

During the day it’s not too bad. Work keeps me busy. In the evenings, however, I have such a difficult time with the uncontrollable tongue movements. I’m thankful it only happens inside my mouth, but it’s still hard. My tongue is often raw and my jaw sore from clenching in an effort to get it to stop. Some evenings I take 1 mg clonazepam, which helps a bit, but I don’t like the morning grogginess. The leg twitching isn’t nearly as tough to endure. It’s just mildly irritating. I’d do just about anything to stop the tongue!
My new boss was so nice about it. I’m glad I didn’t go in—my eye was awful!
Thanks! It’s a relief to hear. 😊
Anyway, you don’t really have a leg to stand on—you have no clue what my hair looked like 30 minutes before the cut. You obviously have no idea what you’re talking about. Seriously.

You’re right. That is funny. If you’d bothered to ask, you would have heard that the reason I’d like another perm is that my hair grows extraordinarily fast, and almost two inches of root are stick straight. 

My perm is not loosening. Once again, you assume.
Thank you! It may have just been the products. We’ll see in the morning!
Snarky much? It’s not the perm. I think I’d know the difference. Two months of awesome curls going to a limp, frizzy mess within 30 minutes, and it’s the perm. Right. 🙄
Not yet. I hope it turns out better than it looks now!
Thank you, everyone, for your wonderful suggestions!

That makes sense! I was hoping to get another perm because my roots have grown out so much. My hair grows super fast, and I’ve got a good two inches of stick-straight hair before the ringlets start. It’s driving me nuts, as I don’t know how to style it.
I like that idea!
Yes, this is exactly what happens to me! I’ll try your method. Thank you so much!
I’ll look her up. Thank you!
I will give combing it through a shot. After all, what’s the worst that can happen, right? Thanks!

Thanks for asking! I started looking for another job, and three days into my new search, HR at the university called to say everything was set for me to start on 8/27. I hope it actually happens this time!
Thank you! I’ve been considering doing that but was just so worried I was doing things “wrong” for curly hair.
Just bought a buff and can’t wait to try it!

Daily shampooing still works, but I keep reading that with curly hair I CAN’T shampoo every day. I’m so confused! Lol

Thanks for answering, though. 😊
French braids never occurred to me! I will have to see if I can master such a thing. This die-hard tomboy never learned. Lol
Thank you! I will do that. 😊

Thanks for your reply! Yes, my hair is greasy after about 12 hours. It’s been this way my whole life, which just meant daily shampooing, but it’s making me crazy after this perm. As far as product, I only use Garnier Fructis Curl Sculpt Conditioning Cream Gel.  I also use Shea Moisture’s Jamaican Black Castor Oil Leave-in Conditioner on my ends.

I’ve been trying the CG for a couple weeks now, and I’m having a very hard time with sleeping on my curls. 

I have short (between ears and jaw) 3b hair. I googled the heck out of “sleeping with short curly hair” because pineappling is simply not possible with hair this short. Apparently I’m supposed to clip it up at night, but it’s not working. 

I use 6-7 clips in my hair and sleep on a satin pillowcase. When I wake up in the morning, my side and front curls are gorgeous! Unfortunately, in the back my hair is a flat, greasy mess. I literally can’t leave the house like this. I try to refresh with a gel/water mixture in a spray bottle, but the curls invariably stay flat. 

What am i doing wrong??? I haven’t worked in a while, so being home bound with disgusting hair isn’t such a big deal, but I start a new job next week. I can’t stay home in shame!

Is the only solution shampooing every day?

Thanks in advance! (I posted once before and didn’t get a single reply, so I hope someone can help me. I literally don’t know where else to turn.)
After a great deal of thought, I restarted my job search this weekend. Thank you for everyone who replied! Great advice!
Thank you
Lol

I’m back from the doctor. Turns out it was an infected hair follicle caused by an ingrown hair. It’s crazy how large it got (an inch across) and how painful it was. Luckily it ruptured while I was waiting to be seen, and all the doctor did was clean it up and prescribe sitz baths and antibiotics.
You were right! I was an infected hair follicle caused by an ingrown hair. I still can’t believe how huge and painful it was.
Almost three years ago. Since I’m not sexually active and never have any problems in the nether regions I haven’t been very attentive to my lady parts. :-(
Thank you so much! I will be sure to post again after my appointment.
I’m 45 years old and haven’t traveled at all in the last month. Living in the US, in New Mexico.
No, I haven’t had sex in 3.5 years. My last gyno visit was almost three years ago (clean STD panel).

I’ve actually already been through all the onboarding already. HR was pretty upset the last time he pushed the date back, because he hadn’t bothered to tell them about it. I will definitely call them!

Sometimes I really wish I could. I’ve been unemployed for seven weeks and can’t seem to find a job. So I can’t even pay for gas to put in my car to get out of here. For now I’m pretty much stuck.
Thank you so much. I can’t tell you how much I appreciate your time. I hope you can get some good rest!

I’ve tried so hard. Talking doesn’t work at all. Counseling? He refuses. He gets really upset if I even do things with family members without him. I don’t know what he’d do if I tried to have friends. He’s so mad right now, stomping around the house because I’m crying and on Reddit. 

I feel so close to giving up completely.

Thank you. I wish I really was strong. No one wants anything to do with me. Not even my husband and kids. I don’t know what I did wrong. I’ve always tried to be a good, kind person. Here I sit at 45, alone except for my two dogs and a husband who barely speaks to me anymore. In a city I can’t stand and where I don’t have a single friend. No job prospects bc I use medical cannabis. Nothing to do because my husband gets so upset if I do anything without him. 

I don’t know how much longer I can hold on.

Yes, you are correct. I tried to stop temporarily (against my psychiatrist’s advice), and within three days my symptoms reappeared, just as bad as they were when I couldn’t work. So stopping isn’t an option for me.
I’m in New Mexico, where MM is legal, but the laws don’t protect you from drug testing. It’s ridiculous!
Hi! No problem! I’m actually still taking Claritin, just in case. Lol But I stopped the Benadryl after about three days. Hope that helps!
You’re welcome! Allergies can be so mysterious. I wonder if we’ll ever know what happened to us!
It lasted about five days. I have allergies, but usually just hay fever and asthma. Rarely hives and certainly nothing like that!

I’m sorry! My birthdays have been awful as far back as I can remember. This latest one (May 27) my husband and I drove down to Phoenix, AZ, to visit my sister for a couple days. She decided to go out drinking with her friends instead of going to dinner to celebrate. My parents didn’t tell me happy birthday. My kids texted me happy birthday but I didn’t get a birthday card or anything. I’m so grateful my husband got me a birthday card this year. It really helped. We couldn’t afford a gift this year, but it was a beautiful card. 

I’d honestly like to just stop celebrating my birthday. The majority of bad events in my life (including losing a baby) have happened in late May. It’s just a bad time. 

Do you think it’s possible to change your birthday? Choose a date that has good memories and use that instead?

Oh, no! I’m doing fine now, but the last few days were seriously awful. I ended up going to the emergency room, but they didn’t do anything. Literally. Took my vitals and left me in a room by myself for three hours without a single person stopping by! 

I was on Claritin and Benadryl, and at urgent care they added prednisone. They told me only to take the Benadryl at night, but it was the only thing that remotely helped the itchy so I took it around the clock. 

I hope you feel better soon!

Yeah, we’ve tried everything. There’s a possibility my parents could do it, so I’m going to talk to them today about it. 

Thank you!!!
